sections.name: File setup, Context
sections.title: Shared channel setup
sections.what: Creates the shared channel used to pass the open function to claims. Its default value is empty, so claims outside a provider show as plain text.
sections.why: Likely reason: lets any claim open the evidence panel without passing the function down by hand.
sections.watch_out: Anything outside a provider cannot open the dialog.

sections.name: StaticClaims
sections.title: Static wrapper
sections.what: Turns off clicking for everything inside it, so claims show as plain text. Slide thumbnails in the review screen use this.
sections.why: Likely reason: thumbnails are for browsing and should not open dialogs.
sections.watch_out: Placed inside a live provider, it still disables clicks for all content below it.

sections.name: evidenceCitation
sections.title: Citation builder for fact lists
sections.what: Builds a citation record from a list of fact IDs. With IDs, it notes that supporting evidence is recorded. Without IDs, it flags a citation gap.
sections.why: The explanation text says a gap is not proof that public sources do not exist.
sections.watch_out: An empty list is treated as a gap, so a claim with missing data shows a gap message.

sections.name: ClaimLink, safeUrl
sections.title: Clickable claim and link check
sections.what: Makes text a button that opens its citation, or shows the text plainly when no panel is available. The safety check allows only web addresses that start with http or https.
sections.why: Likely reason: blocks unsafe address types in source links.
sections.watch_out: Source links in any other format are dropped without a message.

sections.name: ClaimCitationProvider
sections.title: Provider with citation dialog
sections.what: Holds the claim currently selected. It builds a lookup from slide titles, subtitles, bullets, footnotes and pillar names to citations, then shows the dialog with each linked fact, its recorded status, quote and source, plus snapshot inputs for calculations.
sections.why: The dialog text says the evidence is saved analysis, not a fresh source check.
sections.watch_out: The lookup matches exact text, so any edit to a sentence can break its link to its citation.

summary: Makes claims clickable so a reader can open the evidence behind them, and provides the dialog that shows the linked facts, sources and recorded status.
purpose: Let readers check where each statement on a lessons slide came from.
why: Likely reason: the analysis is meant to be checked by reviewers. The dialog text says it shows saved evidence, not a fresh check.
how: 1. A shared channel passes an open function to any clickable claim below it. 2. Each claim is looked up by its exact text in the recipe to find its citation. 3. If nothing is found, a citation gap record is made. 4. The dialog lists each linked fact with its project, publisher, recorded status, quote, source link and a full citation button. 5. Calculation inputs appear as saved project snapshots.
inputs: Claim text and an optional citation, the recipe (slides, pillars, facts, projects), and callbacks for opening a full citation.
outputs: A dialog on screen, and a call to the full citation callback when a reader asks for it. No data is saved.
risks: Lookup uses exact text, so a changed sentence loses its citation and shows as a gap. Only web addresses starting with http or https are opened.
debug: If a claim shows a citation gap, compare its exact text with the recipe slide text. If a fact shows Missing evidence record, check that the fact exists in the recipe's facts. If source links do nothing, check that the address starts with http or https.
